model_annotation: The two line plots illustrate the performance of different models on "Easy" and "Hard" training sets, with the x-axis labeled "Steps" and a linear scale. The y-axis is unlabeled, but has a linear scale and ranges from approximately 0 to a value slightly above the maximum data point on the plot. The top plot compares "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", with both lines starting around 0 and increasing to a similar maximum value. "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" is represented by a blue line, which starts at approximately 0 and increases to around the same maximum value as "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", represented by a red line, with both lines showing a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations, and having a shaded area around them indicating the range of values. The bottom plot compares "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard", with "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" starting at a lower value than "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" and increasing to a similar maximum value, and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" showing a steeper initial increase. Both lines in the bottom plot exhibit a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations.
